plate.title: B02 · Woven strips with leaf and vein
plate.description: Each actual rectangle owns its stem, leaves and veins through its own public port. Its quarter-related long axis determines the ornament; emergent square gaps stay quiet.

constructionNotes: Each actual rectangle owns its stem, leaves and veins through its own public port. Its quarter-related long axis determines the ornament; emergent square gaps stay quiet.
